name: Cruz–Badiano Nahua plant manuscript
description: A 1552 illustrated manuscript documents plant knowledge authored by Nahua physician Martín de la Cruz and translated into Latin by Juan Badiano.

impact.note: One manuscript recording knowledge its author already held, sent away and unread for centuries; nothing later is known to rest on it.

date.basis: Date of the cited witness; not a claim of origin.

events.statement: The manuscript was prepared in 1552; de la Cruz authored the work and Badiano translated it into Latin.

evidence.supports: The manuscript dates from 1552. Nahua physician Martín de la Cruz authored the work, Juan Badiano translated it into Latin, and Francisco de Mendoza commissioned its preparation. Its illustrations and text document knowledge of plants.

caveats: The witness dates the manuscript, not the origin of Nahua plant knowledge. Francisco de Mendoza commissioned the manuscript; commissioning is not taken as evidence of funding.

research.note: Independent review checked the INAH catalogue’s manuscript date, preparation, commissioning and Latin translation; the manuscript text itself was not independently examined.
